chapters.title: Is your tenant ready for Copilot?
Paul's journey from car audio to SharePoint and Copilot
Old SharePoint content and content lifecycle
Focus weeks and rapid fire round

takeaways: Copilot readiness is a Microsoft 365 project: start with sharing settings, permissions, retention, sensitivity labels and DLP, including Power Automate DLP for connectors.
Old, unarchived SharePoint content and duplicate versions make Copilot look like it hallucinates, so archive or restrict content and keep metadata and folder structures simple.
Strong adoption comes from continuous, outcome-focused support in the business rather than one-time training days, while token-based tools like Copilot Cowork need cost awareness.
hook: Buying Copilot licenses is easy, but Copilot then surfaces years of SharePoint, Teams and OneDrive content that was never meant to be shared. In this episode, Microsoft MVP Paul Keijzers explains to IT leaders and Microsoft 365 admins what a Copilot-ready tenant really means. You get practical advice on oversharing, Purview labels and DLP, content lifecycle, adoption and agent governance.
